fields.name: reference_digest
fields.description: Canonical provenance digest of the reference sample the pool was inferred from. Invalidates the pool when the sample changes.

fields.name: model_uri
fields.description: LLM weights URI that produced these values. A different model is a different pool for the same reference sample.

fields.name: column
fields.description: Free-text column the pool belongs to.

fields.name: values
fields.description: Deduped generated values in insertion order. REPEATED (not a JSON blob) so pools stay queryable with UNNEST.

fields.name: stagnated
fields.description: True when the ladder stopped yielding novel values before reaching target. Recorded so later workers read the conclusion instead of re-running the ladder to re-derive it.

fields.name: attempts
fields.description: Ladder attempts spent producing this pool (observability; never a fetch key).
